parameters.query:
SELECT s.display_name,s.email_normalized,s.organisation,s.external_refs,COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('eventId',e.event_id,'eventType',e.event_type,'occurredAt',e.occurred_at,'payload',e.payload) ORDER BY e.occurred_at),'[]'::jsonb) AS journey,$2::jsonb AS booking_event
FROM gwb_launch.subjects s LEFT JOIN gwb_launch.events e USING(subject_key) WHERE s.subject_key=$1::uuid GROUP BY s.subject_key;

parameters.jsCode: const row=$json; const cfg={"site":{"baseUrl":"https://REPLACE_WITH_SITE_URL","allowedOrigins":"https://REPLACE_WITH_SITE_ORIGIN","brandName":"Gary Wilfred-Borilla","garyEmail":"REPLACE_WITH_GARY_EMAIL"},"hubspot":{"baseUrl":"https://api.hubapi.com","scoreProperty":"gwb_intent_score","temperatureProperty":"gwb_intent_temperature","correlationProperty":"gwb_correlation_id","problemProperty":"gwb_primary_problem"},"brevo":{"baseUrl":"https://api.brevo.com/v3","senderName":"Gary Wilfred-Borilla","senderEmail":"REPLACE_WITH_VERIFIED_SENDER_EMAIL"},"webinar":{"provider":"REPLACE_WITH_LIVESTORM_OR_ZOOM","registrationUrl":"https://REPLACE_WITH_WEBINAR_PROVIDER_API/registrations","eventId":"REPLACE_WITH_WEBINAR_EVENT_ID","startsAt":"2026-10-15T18:00:00.000Z","joinUrl":"https://REPLACE_WITH_WEBINAR_JOIN_URL","replayUrl":"https://REPLACE_WITH_REPLAY_URL"},"calendar":{"provider":"cal.com","bookingUrl":"https://cal.com/REPLACE_WITH_GARY/diagnostic"},"openai":{"baseUrl":"https://api.openai.com/v1","model":"gpt-5-mini"},"reporting":{"timezone":"America/Guadeloupe","dailyHour":8,"weeklyDay":"monday"}}; const journey=typeof row.journey==='string'?JSON.parse(row.journey):row.journey; const booking=typeof row.booking_event==='string'?JSON.parse(row.booking_event):row.booking_event; const instructions="Prépare un brief factuel en français pour Gary avant un appel. Résume le contexte déclaré, le problème, les interactions, les signaux d'intention et les questions à éclaircir. Ne pose aucun diagnostic définitif, ne promets aucun résultat et n'invente rien."; return [{json:{...booking,_config:cfg,briefRequest:{model:cfg.openai.model,input:[{role:'system',content:[{type:'input_text',text:instructions}]},{role:'user',content:[{type:'input_text',text:JSON.stringify({contact:{name:row.display_name,email:row.email_normalized,organisation:row.organisation},journey})}]}]}}}];

const event=$('Prepare Brief Prompt').item.json; const output=$json.output_text||($json.output||[]).flatMap(o=>o.content||[]).map(c=>c.text||'').join('\n')||'Brief indisponible : consultez le parcours brut.'; const esc=(value)=>String(value??'').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(//g,'>').replace(/"/g,'"').replace(/'/g,'''); return [{json:{...event,brief:output,notification:{priority:'high',subject:'[Gary Launch] Brief pré-appel — '+(event.booking?.name||event.normalizedEmail),html:'
